FRONTEND-DEV appended 'en' to src/i18n/routing.ts's locales array (defaultLocale unchanged) and created messages/en.json (177 keys duplicated verbatim from ru.json, except Metadata.ogLocale='en_US'). No changes to request.ts/LocaleSwitcher.tsx/layout.tsx. Check against the design system, docs/agents/anti-patterns.md, scope (does the diff do exactly what REQ-003 asked, no more no less — should contain only routing.ts + messages/en.json, no drive-by changes to other files), and consistency with docs/agents/decisions/ records.
acceptance_criteria: Diff is scoped to exactly src/i18n/routing.ts and messages/en.json (plus handoff/log bookkeeping files) — no unrelated changes
messages/en.json's key set verified to match messages/ru.json's exactly (independent check, not trusting FRONTEND-DEV's report)
No design-system violation (this change has no visual surface, but confirm no stray CSS/component edit crept in)
FAIL if a genuine violation found; otherwise PASS with any non-blocking notes recorded

result.summary: Read git diff master...HEAD directly (11 files, +648/-12). Confirmed the two functional-scope files are exactly what REQ-003 asked: src/i18n/routing.ts's `locales` array changed from ["ru","uz"] to ["ru","uz","en"] with defaultLocale left at "ru" (single-line diff, no other edit to the file); messages/en.json is new, 205 lines. request.ts, LocaleSwitcher.tsx, and [locale]/layout.tsx are untouched, matching the design doc's §0 no-change findings. All other diffed files are the expected workflow bookkeeping (docs/agents/design/REQ-003.md, docs/agents/requirements.yaml status flips REQ-003/REQ-004 pending->in_progress, docs/status/requirement_status.yaml started-events for both, handoffs/WF02-REQ003-REQ004/step-00/01/01b/02 completions, handoffs/orchestrator.log) — no stray file in project root, no drive-by src/ or public/ edit outside the one routing.ts line. Independently verified messages/en.json's key set against messages/ru.json with my own Node script (not FRONTEND-DEV's report): leafKeys(en).length===177, leafKeys(ru).length===177, zero keys missing from en, zero extra keys in en — exact match. Also diffed every leaf value pairwise: the only value that differs from ru.json is Metadata.ogLocale ("en_US" vs "ru_RU"); all other 176 keys are verbatim-identical to ru.json, consistent with the design doc's stated placeholder rule and REQ-001a's established ru_RU/uz_UZ precedent for this field. Design-system check: no visual/CSS/component surface in this diff (routing config + JSON data file only) — confirmed no stray .tsx/.css edit crept in. docs/agents/anti-patterns.md's two logged entries (result.status vs handoff status confusion; clock-drift timestamps) don't recur here — this handoff's own result.status is a legal value (PASS) distinct from its lifecycle status (COMPLETED), and started_at/completed_at were read from the actual clock (`date -u`). Checked docs/agents/decisions/0002-content-ba-owns-message-catalogs.md for consistency: that decision governs REQ-004's translation-content step (CONTENT-BA writes messages/*.json content directly), not REQ-003, which is FRONTEND-DEV's routing/seeding step per the requirement's own owner field and design doc — no conflict; REQ-003 seeding a placeholder catalog structurally (verbatim-duplicated values, not translated content) is consistent with 0002's framing that FRONTEND-DEV was never meant to hand-copy real translated content, and no real translation content was written here. Independently re-ran npm run lint: 0 errors, 4 warnings, all four pre-existing and in files this diff never touches (Avatar.jsx, Footer.tsx, Nav.tsx) — consistent with FRONTEND-DEV's report. No genuine violation found. Non-blocking note: none beyond what's already flagged as an open/resolved question in the design doc (ogLocale value, already resolved at Step 1b).
